rows.en: ＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０１５Um... I'm sorry for letting￥myself in.＝＠１８６＿０１６I heard you collapsed,￥and I was worried...＝＠１８６＿０１７Um, how are you feeling?
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０１９When you're overworked, the best￥thing is to eat well and get￥plenty of sleep.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０２１Training hard is good, but￥please take better care￥of yourself.＝＠１８６＿０２２If you want to qualify, your￥body is your greatest asset.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０２３You've been training almost￥too hard lately, haven't you?
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０２４So please, take this chance￥to get some proper rest today.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０２５Yes, I think that's best.￥Everyone needs a rest sometimes.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０２６You mustn't. When you're unwell,￥pushing yourself won't make you￥any more productive.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０２８Don't rush things. Just focus￥on getting better soon, okay?
＊Tomoe＊＠１８６＿０２９Well, I should be going now,￥but please stay in bed.＝＠１８６＿０３０I'm sorry for all the fuss.
